# Pervasive Displays

[E2213KS0E1 preset](e2213ks0e1/preset.json) uses the manufacturer's tentative 2023-04-17 datasheet, reviewed through a distributor mirror: 16.56 mJ per 2.4 s full refresh. Idle power remains null; the app requires explicit input before creating a runnable instance. The catalog therefore has no manufacturer `part.json`. [Characterization](e2213ks0e1/characterization.json) retains physical pins, typical peak current and source limitations. See the [datasheet comparison](../../docs/EINK-DATASHEETS.md).
